title: Chicago vacation: Earl Hines and Louis Armstrong in 1928
summary: On a break he hears Earl Hines with Jimmy Noone at the Apex Club and Louis Armstrong with Carroll Dickerson.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Swazey still worked with us - this fella Swayzee, I told you who left and went with -- with Cab Calloway. We finished the season, we took the boat to Davenport, Iowa, for drydock, then the band had a little recess -- for vacation, and a group of us went to Chicago, that's where I had a chance to first hear Earl Hines at the Apex Club, playing piano with Jimmy Noone. Earl Hines had just made those records with Jimmy Noone, and his name had just popped up in 1928.

His records were hot then. And, I ran into Louis Armstrong, who was playing trumpet at the Savoy Ballroom in the Carroll Dickerson's band. Carroll Dickerson was a fiddle player. And Louis Armstrong was playing in the band with Carroll Dickerson.
